newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues tender to buy jet fuel for December.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues tender to buy jet fuel for December.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 32,000 tonnes of aviation jet fuel for delivery in December, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The cargo is for delivery to Keelung or Shen Ao on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis. The tender closes on November 6 and offers will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought two 32,000 tonne-cargoes of jet fuel from two traders at around $247 a tonne, for end-October and early November arrival, c-and-f.
